_about: OWNER file: the numbers of this project that differ from the registry defaults. Changed only through `python3 gate/tools/gate.py owner param NAME VALUE --tag T --source "..."`. Each entry is {"value", "tag", "source", "date"}; tag M = measured on a print or on the bought part in hand, U = owner decision, D = decided and not printed, S = simulated. A value looser than the default needs M or U. A fit tagged M also holds "measured_under": the nozzle, material, X-Y hole compensation and layer height of the project it was printed from (the command fills it in from the declared target); for any other project that fit counts as D. Registry defaults that say "placeholder" (a plug, a magnet, a switch) are meant to be replaced by what was measured here. The entries under _example show the shape; keys that start with _ are not read.

motors.plug_width.source: caliper on the plug in hand
